script:
-- ============================================================
-- PROTECT BY ZERO - ULTIMATE EDITION (BAGIAN 1 / 2)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Dynamic Shared State Engine

    InfJump = false,

_G.PBZ_SelectedPlayer = nil
_G.PBZ_LoopBringTarget = nil

local States = _G.PBZ_States

end

-- ScreenGui Setup

-- Main Dashboard Interface

FloatingLogoBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.25, 0)

local logoDragging, logoDragStart, logoStartPos

local MinimizeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

MinimizeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
MinimizeBtn.Text = "_"
MinimizeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MinimizeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
MinimizeBtn.TextSize = 14

local MinCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

MinCorner.Parent = MinimizeBtn

-- TopBar Dragging Logic
local dragging, dragStart, startPos
TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)

end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

local ContentContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
ContentContainer.Name = "ContentContainer"
ContentContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -60)
ContentContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 54)
ContentContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ContentContainer.Parent = MainFrame

-- Fold Engine - Ultra Thick Glow Stroke
local isFolded = false
FoldBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isFolded = not isFolded
    if isFolded then
        FoldBtn.Text = "+"
        ContentContainer.Visible = false
        BackgroundImg.Visible = false
        
        TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 50)
        }):Play()
        MainStroke.Thickness = 7.5
        MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 120)
    else
        FoldBtn.Text = "—"
        BackgroundImg.Visible = true
        MainStroke.Thickness = 3
        MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
        
        local tw = TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 660, 0, 460)
        })
        tw:Play()
        tw.Completed:Connect(function()
            if not isFolded then ContentContainer.Visible = true end
        end)
    end
end)

MinimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    MainFrame.Visible = false
    FloatingLogoBtn.Visible = true
end)

FloatingLogoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    FloatingLogoBtn.Visible = false
    MainFrame.Visible = true
end)

-- Navigation Sidebar
local Sidebar = Instance.new("Frame")
Sidebar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 135, 1, 0)
Sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65
Sidebar.BorderSizePixel = 0
Sidebar.Parent = ContentContainer

local SideCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SideCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
SideCorner.Parent = Sidebar

local SideList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
SideList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
SideList.Parent = Sidebar

local PageContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
PageContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -145, 1, 0)
PageContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 145, 0, 0)
PageContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
PageContainer.Parent = ContentContainer

_G.PBZ_Pages = {}

function _G.PBZ_CreateTab(name)
    local TabBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    TabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
    TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 24)
    TabBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    TabBtn.Text = name:upper()
    TabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
    TabBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    TabBtn.TextSize = 11
    TabBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    TabBtn.Parent = Sidebar

    local TabCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    TabCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    TabCorner.Parent = TabBtn

    local PageScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    PageScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    PageScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    PageScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
    PageScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    PageScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
    PageScroll.Visible = false
    PageScroll.Parent = PageContainer

    local UIGrid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
    UIGrid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 158, 0, 42)
    UIGrid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
    UIGrid.StartCorner = Enum.StartCorner.TopLeft
    UIGrid.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    UIGrid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    UIGrid.Parent = PageScroll

    _G.PBZ_Pages[name] = {Btn = TabBtn, Page = PageScroll}

    TabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, p in pairs(_G.PBZ_Pages) do
            p.Page.Visible = false
            p.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 24)
            p.Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
        end
        PageScroll.Visible = true
        TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
        TabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end)

    return PageScroll
end

function _G.PBZ_CreateToggle(page, text, key, callback)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
    Btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    Btn.Text = text:upper() .. ": OFF"
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    Btn.TextSize = 10
    Btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Btn.Parent = page

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    Corner.Parent = Btn

    local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
    Stroke.Thickness = 1
    Stroke.Parent = Btn

    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        States[key] = not States[key]
        if States[key] then
            Btn.Text = text:upper() .. ": ON"
            Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
            Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 160)
        else
            Btn.Text = text:upper() .. ": OFF"
            Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
            Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
            Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
        end
        if callback then callback(States[key]) end
    end)
    return Btn
end

function _G.PBZ_CreateActionBtn(page, text, callback)

-- Render Loop For Crosshair & GUI Visual Effects
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if States.Crosshair then
        local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        CrosshairCircle.Position = mousePos
        CrosshairCircle.Radius = States.CrosshairSize
        CrosshairCircle.Color = States.CrosshairColor
        CrosshairCircle.Thickness = States.CrosshairThickness
        CrosshairCircle.Visible = true
    else
        CrosshairCircle.Visible = false
    end

    if States.RainbowGUI and TargetParent:FindFirstChild("ProtectByZeroGui") then
        local hue = (tick() % 4) / 4
        MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1)
    end

    if States.TargetFOV then
        FOVCircle.Position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        FOVCircle.Radius = States.ProximityDist
        FOVCircle.Visible = true
    else
        FOVCircle.Visible = false
    end
end)
-- ============================================================
-- PROTECT BY ZERO - ULTIMATE EDITION (BAGIAN 2 / 2)
-- COMBAT ENGINE, MOVEMENT, SERVER UTILS & 9 PLAYER ACTIONS
-- ============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local States = _G.PBZ_States

-- Generate Tabs
local CombatPage   = _G.PBZ_CreateTab("COMBAT")
local VisualsPage  = _G.PBZ_CreateTab("VISUALS")
local MovementPage = _G.PBZ_CreateTab("MOVEMENT")
local ServerPage   = _G.PBZ_CreateTab("SERVER")
local PlayerPage   = _G.PBZ_CreateTab("PLAYERS")

_G.PBZ_Pages["COMBAT"].Page.Visible = true
_G.PBZ_Pages["COMBAT"].Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
_G.PBZ_Pages["COMBAT"].Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

local function isValidTarget(plr)
    if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return false end
    
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not root then return false end
    if char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return false end
    if char.Parent and char.Parent.Name:lower():find("lobby") then return false end
    
    return true
end

local function getClosestPlayerInWorld(maxDistance)
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = maxDistance or math.huge
    local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isValidTarget(plr) then
            local enemyRoot = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local dist = (enemyRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < shortestDist then
                shortestDist = dist
                target = plr
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

local function getClosestPlayerToCursor()
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isValidTarget(plr) then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
            if onScreen then
                local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local dist = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
                if dist < shortestDist then
                    shortestDist = dist
                    target = plr
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

-- Render Stepped Executions
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    -- Loop Bring Feature
    if _G.PBZ_LoopBringTarget and isValidTarget(_G.PBZ_LoopBringTarget) then
        local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myRoot then
            _G.PBZ_LoopBringTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = myRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4)
        end
    end

    if States.CustomFOV then
        Camera.FieldOfView = States.CustomFOV
    end

    -- Combat Features
    if States.AutoAimProximity then
        local nearPlr = getClosestPlayerInWorld(States.ProximityDist)
        if nearPlr and nearPlr.Character and nearPlr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, nearPlr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
        end
    end

    if States.AimLock then
        if not _G.PBZ_CurrentTarget or not isValidTarget(_G.PBZ_CurrentTarget) then
            _G.PBZ_CurrentTarget = getClosestPlayerInWorld() or getClosestPlayerToCursor()
        end
        if _G.PBZ_CurrentTarget and _G.PBZ_CurrentTarget.Character and _G.PBZ_CurrentTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, _G.PBZ_CurrentTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
        end
    end

    if States.Aimbot then
        local target = getClosestPlayerToCursor()
        if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, target.Character.Head.Position)
        end
    end

    if States.HitboxExpander then
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if isValidTarget(plr) then
                pcall(function()
                    local hrp = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                    hrp.Size = Vector3.new(States.HitboxSize, States.HitboxSize, States.HitboxSize)
                    hrp.Transparency = 0.7
                    hrp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
                    hrp.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    hrp.CanCollide = false
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    if States.SpinBot and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0)
    end

    if States.TriggerBot then
        local mouseTarget = LocalPlayer:GetMouse().Target
        if mouseTarget and mouseTarget.Parent then
            local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(mouseTarget.Parent) or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(mouseTarget.Parent.Parent)
            if plr and isValidTarget(plr) then
                mouse1click()
            end
        end
    end

    if States.AntiKnockback and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local root = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
        root.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, root.Velocity.Y, 0)
        root.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end

    if States.KillAura then
        local target = getClosestPlayerInWorld(16)
        if target then
            local tool = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool then tool:Activate() end
        end
    end

    -- Tracers Rendering
    if States.ESP_Tracers then
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if isValidTarget(plr) then
                local line = _G.PBZ_Tracers[plr] or Drawing.new("Line")
                line.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
                line.Thickness = 1.5
                line.Transparency = 0.85
                
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    line.From = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                    line.To = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
                    line.Visible = true
                else
                    line.Visible = false
                end
                _G.PBZ_Tracers[plr] = line
            elseif _G.PBZ_Tracers[plr] then
                _G.PBZ_Tracers[plr].Visible = false
            end
        end
    else
        for _, line in pairs(_G.PBZ_Tracers) do line.Visible = false end
    end
end)

-- Noclip & Anti-AFK Logic

-- VISUALS TAB BINDINGS
local function applyFullBodyESP(plr)
    if not plr.Character then return end
    local existingHL = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("ESP_Highlight")
    if States.ESP then
        if not existingHL then
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
            hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
            hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
            hl.Adornee = plr.Character
            hl.Parent = plr.Character
        end
    else
        if existingHL then existingHL:Destroy() end
    end
end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if plr ~= LocalPlayer then applyFullBodyESP(plr) end end

local function populateServerPlayers()
    for _, c in ipairs(PlrListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end
    end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local Card = Instance.new("TextButton")
        Card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
        Card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
        Card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
        Card.Text = ""
        Card.Parent = PlrListFrame

        local CardCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        CardCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        CardCorner.Parent = Card

        local AvatarImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        AvatarImg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
        AvatarImg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
        AvatarImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        AvatarImg.Image = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(plr.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
        AvatarImg.Parent = Card

        local AvatarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        AvatarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        AvatarCorner.Parent = AvatarImg

        local Info = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        Info.Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0)
        Info.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 0)
        Info.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Info.Text = string.format("%s (@%s)", plr.DisplayName, plr.Name)
        Info.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        Info.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
        Info.TextSize = 9
        Info.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        Info.Parent = Card

        Card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            _G.PBZ_SelectedPlayer = plr
            SelectedLabel.Text = "TARGET: " .. plr.Name:upper()
        end)
    end
end

RefreshBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(populateServerPlayers)
task.spawn(populateServerPlayers)
